title: SchoolConfig
description: Matching and dispatch configuration for one school (rule 9). Collection: schoolConfigs, document ID is the school ID. Each version is copied to schoolConfigs/{schoolId}/versions/{version}. The police certificate filter is deliberately not configurable (rule 10).

dispatchEnabled.description: Kill switch. False stops all outgoing messages for the school (plan 8.4).

weights.title: ScoreWeights
weights.description: Each 0 to 1. Must sum to 1, which the matching engine checks (step 3).

filters.title: HardFilters
filters.description: Hard filters that a school may switch off (plan 7.2). Active status and police certificate always apply.

formalCompetenceSubjects.description: Subjects where only formally qualified substitutes may be asked.

formalCompetence.title: FormalCompetenceRule
formalCompetence.description: Who counts as formally qualified in a subject. Temporary until the school's rules are known (open-questions 2).

minLevel.description: Lowest competence level in the subject, 1 to 3.

maxOpenOffersPerSubstitute.description: A substitute with this many unanswered offers gets no new ones, except for urgent and critical shifts (plan 7.4).

waves.title: WaveTable
waves.description: Wave rules per urgency, chosen by time until the shift starts (plan 7.5).

quietHours.title: QuietHours
quietHours.description: No messages between start and end, local time. The window may pass midnight.

smsFallbackDelaySeconds.description: Seconds to wait for a push to be opened before sending SMS.

maxSmsPerDay.description: Safety cap per school per day (plan 8.4).

minMinutesBeforeStart.description: This rule applies when at least this many minutes remain until start.

waveSize.description: Candidates per wave. Null means all qualified.

intervalMinutes.description: Minutes between waves. Null means a single dispatch.

deadlineMinutes.description: Minutes from first dispatch until escalation.
